scenarios.scenario: Open and closes an empty browser search while editing a sketch

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open in the MCAD Software
Sketch1 is being edited
the model browser is visible with its search field closed
the user selects the browser search control
an empty search field appears beneath the browser header
the model browser tree and sketch viewport remain visible
the user selects the close control on the empty search field
the search field is hidden
the browser tree and sketch viewport remain visible

scenarios.scenario: Select an origin axis from the browser during sketch editing

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open in the MCAD Software
Sketch1 is being edited
the Origin branch is expanded in the model browser
the user selects the X Axis entry in the browser
the X Axis entry is highlighted in the browser
the sketch remains visible in the viewport

scenarios.scenario: Inspect browser display preferences during sketch editing

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open in the MCAD Software
Sketch1 is being edited
the model browser is visible
Auto expand Representations Folder on Open is enabled for the captured session
the user opens the browser header menu
the user expands Display Preferences
the submenu offers Hide UCS, Hide Work Features, Hide Notes, Hide Documents and Hide Warnings
it offers Show Extended Names and Hide Blue Dot Indicator
it offers Auto expand Representations Folder on Open and Design View Expansion
Auto expand Representations Folder on Open is checked
the sketch viewport remains visible

scenarios.scenario: Hide and restore work-feature entries in the part browser

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open in the MCAD Software
Sketch1 is being edited
the model browser shows an expanded Origin branch
Hide Work Features is unchecked in browser Display Preferences
the user selects Hide Work Features
the Origin branch is hidden from the browser
the sketch entries and sketch viewport remain visible
the user reopens browser Display Preferences
Hide Work Features is checked
the user selects Hide Work Features again
the Origin branch returns to the browser in a collapsed state
the sketch entries and sketch viewport remain visible

scenarios.scenario: Show and hide extended feature names in the browser

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is active in the MCAD Software with a 20 mm new-solid extrusion
Show Extended Names is unchecked in browser Display Preferences
the extrusion is displayed with its short feature name
the user selects Show Extended Names
the extrusion's browser label includes its new-solid operation and 20 mm depth
the solid remains visible in the viewport
the user reopens browser Display Preferences
Show Extended Names is checked
the user selects Show Extended Names again
the extrusion is displayed with its short feature name
the solid remains visible in the viewport

scenarios.scenario: Inspect the context menu for a browser feature

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is active in the MCAD Software with a solid extrusion
its extrusion feature is visible in the model browser
the user right-clicks the extrusion feature in the browser
a context menu opens beside the feature row
the menu offers Edit Sketch, Edit Feature and Show Dimensions
it offers Copy, Delete, Measure and Properties
it offers Expand All Children and Collapse All Children
the extrusion row and the solid edges are highlighted
the user clicks an empty area of the viewport outside the menu
the context menu closes
the extrusion row and solid edges remain highlighted

scenarios.scenario: Expand and collapse an extrusion's browser children

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is active in the MCAD Software with an extrusion and its underlying sketch
the extrusion branch is collapsed in the model browser
the user right-clicks the extrusion and chooses Expand All Children
the extrusion branch displays its sketch child
the solid remains visible in the viewport
the user right-clicks the extrusion and chooses Collapse All Children
the extrusion branch still displays its direct sketch child
the solid remains visible in the viewport

scenarios.scenario: Inspect the context menu for a sketch under an extrusion

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is active in the MCAD Software with an extrusion and its underlying dimensioned sketch
the extrusion branch is expanded in the model browser
the user right-clicks the sketch child in the browser
a context menu opens beside the sketch row
the menu offers Edit Sketch, Redefine, Share Sketch and Properties
it offers Measure, Visibility and Export Sketch As
the sketch row is highlighted
the sketch geometry and dimensions are highlighted over the solid
the user clicks an empty area of the viewport outside the menu
the context menu closes
the sketch row, geometry and dimensions remain highlighted
the user clicks the empty viewport area again
the sketch row is no longer highlighted
the highlighted sketch geometry and dimensions disappear from the viewport
the solid remains visible

scenarios.scenario: Expand and collapse Origin children from its context menu

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is active in the MCAD Software with a visible solid
the Origin branch is collapsed in the model browser
the user right-clicks Origin
its context menu offers Expand All Children and Collapse All Children
the user chooses Expand All Children
Origin displays its plane, axis and center-point child rows
the solid remains visible in the viewport
the user right-clicks Origin and chooses Collapse All Children
the direct plane, axis and center-point rows remain visible under Origin
the solid remains visible in the viewport

scenarios.scenario: Inspect the context menu for an Origin plane

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is active in the MCAD Software with a visible solid
the Origin branch is expanded in the model browser
Auto-Resize is enabled for the YZ Plane in the captured session
the user right-clicks the YZ Plane row
a context menu opens beside the plane row
the menu offers New Sketch, Measure, Visibility and Auto-Resize
Auto-Resize is checked in this session
the plane row is highlighted
the corresponding plane is highlighted as a blue translucent surface in the viewport
the user clicks an empty area of the viewport outside the menu
the context menu closes
the plane row and translucent plane remain highlighted
the user clicks the empty viewport area again
the plane selection is cleared
the highlighted plane is no longer displayed
the solid remains visible

scenarios.scenario: Inspect the context menu for an Origin axis

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is active in the MCAD Software with a visible solid
the Origin branch is expanded in the model browser
Auto-Resize is enabled for the Y Axis in the captured session
the user right-clicks the Y Axis row
a context menu opens beside the axis row
the menu offers Copy, Measure, Visibility and Auto-Resize
Auto-Resize is checked in this session
the axis row is highlighted
the corresponding axis is highlighted in the viewport
the user clicks an empty area of the viewport outside the menu
the context menu closes
the axis row and axis remain highlighted
the user clicks the empty viewport area again
the axis is no longer highlighted in the viewport
the axis row no longer has the filled selection highlight
the axis row retains a focus outline
the solid remains visible

scenarios.scenario: Inspect the context menu for the Origin center point

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is active in the MCAD Software with a visible solid
the Origin branch is expanded in the model browser
the user right-clicks the Center Point row
a context menu opens beside the point row
the menu offers Copy, Measure, Create Note, Visibility and Relationships
the Center Point row is highlighted
the user clicks an empty area of the viewport outside the menu
the context menu closes
the Center Point row remains highlighted
the user clicks the empty viewport area again
the Center Point row no longer has the filled selection highlight
the Center Point row retains a focus outline
the solid remains visible in the viewport

scenarios.scenario: Expand and collapse nested entries in the solid-bodies folder

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is active in the MCAD Software with one solid body made from an extrusion and sketch
the Solid Bodies folder is collapsed in the model browser
the user right-clicks Solid Bodies
its context menu offers Visibility, Expand All Children and Collapse All Children
the user chooses Expand All Children
the folder displays the body row
the body displays its extrusion and underlying sketch as nested rows
the solid remains visible in the viewport
the user right-clicks Solid Bodies and chooses Collapse All Children
the body row remains visible beneath the folder
the extrusion and sketch rows beneath that body are hidden
the solid remains visible in the viewport
